editors_pick.title: Anthropic found a hidden space where Claude puzzles over concepts
editors_pick.title_cn: Anthropic破解Claude“隐藏思维空间”，首次揭示LLM内部推理机制
editors_pick.summary: The AI firm Anthropic has developed a technique that has given it the clearest glimpse yet at what’s really going on inside large language models as they answer questions or carry out tasks. What they
editors_pick.summary_cn: Anthropic开发出全新解析技术，首次清晰揭示LLM在处理任务时的内部“思考”过程。这一突破显著提升了AI模型的可解释性，有助于构建更安全、透明的人工智能系统。

editors_pick.title: GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot
editors_pick.title_cn: Microsoft 365 Copilot全面接入GPT-5.6，大幅提升Office办公效率
editors_pick.summary: Learn how GPT-5.6 powers Microsoft 365 Copilot with stronger AI capabilities across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Chat, and Cowork for faster, higher-quality work.
editors_pick.summary_cn: 微软将GPT-5.6确立为Microsoft 365 Copilot的首选大模型，为Word、Excel等全线办公软件注入更强AI能力。此举将帮助用户大幅缩短工作时间，产出更高质量的办公成果。

editors_pick.title: ChatGPT is now a partner for your most ambitious work
editors_pick.title_cn: ChatGPT化身专属工作Agent：跨应用操作，将目标直接转化为成果
editors_pick.summary: ChatGPT Work is an agent that can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.
editors_pick.summary_cn: OpenAI将ChatGPT升级为能跨应用操作的智能Agent。该Agent可连续数小时专注单一项目，自动处理各类文件，直接帮用户将抽象的宏大目标转化为最终的高质量工作成果。

editors_pick.title: An AI agent startup just let its agent run its $100 million fundraise
editors_pick.title_cn: 初创公司Lyzr用自家AI Agent主导1亿美元融资，实力验证产品商用价值
editors_pick.summary: Lyzr, a startup that builds AI agents for enterprises, used its own AI agent to raise a $100 million round — proof, evidently, that the product actually works.
editors_pick.summary_cn: 企业级Agent开发商Lyzr使用自家研发的AI Agent，成功主导并完成1亿美元融资。此举不仅完美验证了其产品的真实效用，更证明了Agent独立处理复杂商业任务的巨大潜力。

editors_pick.title: OpenAI launches its new family of models with GPT-5.6
editors_pick.title_cn: OpenAI发布GPT-5.6全新模型家族，强化网络安全与企业级应用
editors_pick.summary: OpenAI's latest family of models promise improvements across a range of areas, including cybersecurity.
editors_pick.summary_cn: OpenAI正式发布GPT-5.6全新模型家族。该系列在整体性能上实现大幅提升，并重点强化了网络安全防护能力，将帮助企业更高效地应对复杂安全威胁，构建更可靠的AI生态。

items.title: Synthetic Data Generation for Financial AI Research with NVIDIA NeMo
items.title_cn: NVIDIA NeMo生成合成数据：解决金融LLM训练数据匮乏难题
items.summary: Fine-tuning LLMs for financial natural language processing (NLP) is constrained by limited, imbalanced data. Real-world financial news overrepresents earnings...
items.summary_cn: 金融领域的LLM微调常受限于数据匮乏和分布不均。NVIDIA NeMo通过生成合成数据，有效解决真实金融新闻数据偏科问题，大幅提升金融AI的分析精度。

items.title: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 API pricing squeezes OpenAI and Anthropic as the AI price war heats up
items.title_cn: Meta发布Muse Spark 1.1 API：每百万tokens仅4.25美元，大幅降低开发成本
items.summary: Meta is entering the AI API business with Muse Spark 1.1 at prices that undercut even the dirt-cheap Grok 4.5, released just yesterday. At $4.25 per million output tokens, Meta charges a fraction of w
items.summary_cn: Meta正式进军AI API市场，Muse Spark 1.1每百万输出tokens收费仅4.25美元。这一极具破坏力的价格远低于OpenAI，开发者能以极低成本接入大模型。

items.title: OpenAI Fixes 18-Year-Old GNU libunwind Bug by Treating Crash Debugging Like Epidemiology
items.title_cn: OpenAI修复存在18年的底层Bug：用流行病学方法提升系统稳定性
items.summary: OpenAI found two unrelated bugs masquerading as one in ChatGPT's data infrastructure. Silent hardware corruption on one Azure host and an 18-year-old race condition in GNU libunwind's setcontext funct
items.summary_cn: OpenAI团队利用流行病学方法，成功排查并修复了影响ChatGPT基础设施的两个隐蔽Bug，包括一个存在18年之久的GNU libunwind竞态条件，大幅提升系统稳定性。

items.title: 7 Steps to Automating Descriptive Statistics with Python
items.title_cn: 告别重复代码：7步用Python自动化生成专业描述性统计报表
items.summary: Stop writing mean() and std() for every column. Learn how to automate descriptive statistics in Python and generate publication-ready summary tables in just a few steps.
items.summary_cn: 无需再为每列数据手写mean()等函数。本文教你只需7步即可用Python实现描述性统计自动化，直接生成可直接用于报告的专业汇总表，大幅提升数据分析效率。

items.title: Running OpenClaw with Ollama
items.title_cn: 基于Ollama部署OpenClaw：零基础搭建Telegram专属研究Agent
items.summary: This article covers the full path from zero to a running private research assistant on Telegram, including configuring the context length correctly, connecting the channel, enabling web search, and de
items.summary_cn: 本文提供从零开始的完整教程，教你用Ollama配置OpenClaw上下文长度并接入Telegram，打造具备联网搜索能力的私人研究Agent，全面保护数据隐私。

items.title: 扎克伯格为Meta付费人工智能工具制定“激进”价格策略
items.title_cn: Meta发布Muse Spark 1.1：首次推出付费API，主打市场最低价
items.summary: Meta Platforms Inc．发布了其最先进人工智能模型Muse Spark 1.1，并首次面向开发者推出付费版本。这是Meta首次向企业收取模型使用费，也为公司开辟了新的收入来源。扎克伯格在发布前接受采访时表示，这款模型将成为市场上价格最低的选择之一。“由于这不是开源模型，我认为这是我们第一次真正认真推出API，”扎克伯格说，“其定价将极具竞争力，也非常有吸引力。”（新浪财经）
items.summary_cn: Meta发布最先进AI模型Muse Spark 1.1，首次面向企业推出付费API。扎克伯格称该模型定价极具竞争力，主打市场最低价，旨在帮助企业大幅降低AI应用部署成本。

items.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
items.title_cn: OpenAI获政府批准全面推出GPT-5.6，同步发布企业级ChatGPT Work
items.summary: About two weeks after OpenAI's GPT-5.6 was caught up in regulatory drama - rolled out only to government-approved organizations during a "limited preview" period - the company has received the Trump a
items.summary_cn: 结束两周监管波折后，OpenAI获政府批准全面推出GPT-5.6，并同步发布企业级产品ChatGPT Work，为企业提供更安全合规的AI生产力工具。

items.title: Meta says its new AI model is ready to compete on coding
items.title_cn: Meta开放全新AI编程模型：可接入主流工具，大幅提升开发效率
items.summary: After reentering the AI race with its first in-house Muse Spark model in April, Meta is now opening up the doors to developers with a new model that can plug into AI coding software with the new Meta
items.summary_cn: 继4月发布自研模型后，Meta向开发者开放全新AI编程模型，支持直接接入主流AI编程软件。此举旨在帮助程序员显著提升编码效率，全面参与AI代码市场竞争。

items.title: Anthropic Wants You to Pay Up for Claude Fable 5
items.title_cn: Anthropic对Claude Fable 5引入按量计费，AI固定订阅时代终结
items.summary: Claude subscribers must soon pay usage-based fees to access Anthropic’s best consumer AI model—a sign that the golden era of AI subscriptions is ending.
items.summary_cn: Anthropic调整计费策略，要求Claude订阅用户支付额外的按量使用费，才能解锁其最强消费级AI模型。此举标志着固定费用AI订阅模式的终结。

items.title: OpenAI finds roughly 30 percent of popular AI coding test is broken
items.title_cn: OpenAI审查主流AI编程测试：发现30%任务存在严重缺陷
items.summary: OpenAI reviewed SWE-Bench Pro, a widely used test for measuring AI models' programming skills, and found roughly 30 percent of its tasks are broken. The company is pulling its earlier endorsement of t
items.summary_cn: OpenAI审查了用于评估AI模型编程能力的SWE-Bench Pro测试，发现约30%的任务存在缺陷。OpenAI已撤回对该测试的背书，呼吁行业建立更准确的AI能力评估标准。

items.title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
items.title_cn: 上线不足一年即关停：OpenAI终止ChatGPT Atlas浏览器项目
items.summary: OpenAI is already shutting down ChatGPT Atlas, its browser that could do tasks for you on your behalf, less than a year after launching it. Atlas was announced in October, but as part of its wave of n
items.summary_cn: OpenAI宣布关闭可代为执行任务的ChatGPT Atlas浏览器。该项目去年10月才推出，此次关停意味着OpenAI在自主Agent浏览器领域的初步尝试未能达到预期。

items.title: FL Studio 2026 turns its AI chatbot into your assistant engineer
items.title_cn: FL Studio 2026发布：AI助手升级为助理工程师
items.summary: Last year, Image Line introduced Gopher for FL Studio, an AI chatbot that was basically a glorified instruction manual. You asked it how to do something, and it would serve up the relevant instruction
items.summary_cn: Image Line将FL Studio的AI聊天机器人Gopher升级为助理工程师。用户不仅能查询操作指令，AI还能直接辅助处理音频，大幅提升音乐制作效率与工作流体验。

items.title: Character.AI wants a piece of the microdrama pie
items.title_cn: Character.AI推出c.ai系列，正式进军微短剧市场
items.summary: Character.AI's plan to become more than just an LLM-powered chatbot platform is going beyond interactive books, comics, and audio dramas. Today, the company announced the debut of c.ai Series - short-
items.summary_cn: Character.AI不再局限于LLM聊天机器人，宣布推出c.ai系列进军微短剧市场。此举将结合AI互动与短视频内容，为用户拓展全新的娱乐体验和商业化空间。

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol nearly matches Fable 5 on aggregated benchmarks at one-third the cost
items.title_cn: OpenAI发布GPT-5.6 Sol：性能媲美Fable 5，成本仅需三分之一
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol scores 59 points on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, just one point behind Claude Fable 5. At $1.04 per task, it costs a third of what Anthropic's top model charges. In
items.summary_cn: OpenAI的GPT-5.6 Sol在综合基准测试中得分59，仅落后Claude Fable 5一分。其单次任务成本仅1.04美元，不到竞品的三分之一，可帮助企业大幅削减API调用费用。

items.title: Databricks makes Chinese open-source model GLM 5.2 its default coding engine after it matched Opus at lower cost
items.title_cn: Databricks采用中国开源模型GLM 5.2作为默认代码引擎
items.summary: Databricks benchmarked coding agents on its own multi-million-line codebase and found that the Chinese open-source model GLM 5.2 matched Anthropic's Opus 4.8 at $1.28 per task versus $1.94. The compan
items.summary_cn: Databricks测试显示，开源模型GLM 5.2在数百万行代码库上表现媲美Opus 4.8，且单次任务成本降至1.28美元。Databricks已将其设为默认编码Agent引擎以削减开发成本。

items.title: Meta enters the crowded AI coding battle with Muse Spark 1.1
items.title_cn: Meta推出Muse Spark 1.1：专攻企业级代码迁移，进军人工智能(AI)编程赛道
items.summary: Meta's pitch to users is Spark's ability to handle large agentic workloads, fix bugs, and help with large code migrations — the kind of automation that enterprises are increasingly turning to AI compa
items.summary_cn: Meta发布Muse Spark 1.1进军人工智能(AI)编程市场。该工具能处理大型Agent工作负载、修复漏洞并协助大规模代码迁移，直击企业日益增长的自动化转型痛点。

items.title: OpenAI is shutting down Atlas, but its AI browser ambitions are still growing
items.title_cn: OpenAI关停人工智能(AI)浏览器Atlas，Agent功能将整合至桌面端及Chrome插件
items.summary: OpenAI is sunsetting its AI-powered browser after less than a year. But it's moving some agentic browsing features to its desktop app and a Chrome extension.
items.summary_cn: OpenAI上架不到一年即关停人工智能(AI)浏览器Atlas，但并未放弃该领域。原有的Agent浏览功能将迁移至桌面应用和Chrome扩展程序，持续提升用户的自动化体验。

items.title: Can AI answer the $3 trillion question?
items.title_cn: 3万亿美元的ROI考验：人工智能(AI)能否为企业带来真实商业回报？
items.summary: The AI ROI debate has returned and the numbers are even bigger, as are, perhaps, the consequences.
items.summary_cn: 关于人工智能(AI)投资回报率(ROI)的争议再次升温。面对高达3万亿美元的巨额投资预期，企业亟需证明技术落地带来的实际商业价值与深远影响。

items.title: Elon Musk praises Mythos/Fable, promises not to ‘cut off’ Anthropic
items.title_cn: 马斯克承诺不断供Anthropic，400亿美元营收背后的云服务博弈
items.summary: Should Anthropic trust Elon Musk to host its models? With about $40 billion in revenue at stake, Musk insists that the company can.
items.summary_cn: 面对高达400亿美元的营收风险，Anthropic是否应信任马斯克来托管其模型？马斯克近期不仅盛赞竞争对手，更坚决承诺将全面保障其托管服务的稳定。

items.title: OpenAI’s CEO of AGI Deployment Fidji Simo Is Stepping Down
items.title_cn: OpenAI通用人工智能(AGI)应用负责人Fidji Simo宣布离职，转任兼职顾问
items.summary: The move comes after Simo took significant medical leave. Simo will stay on as a part-time advisor.
items.summary_cn: OpenAI通用人工智能(AGI)应用业务CEO Fidji Simo在长期病假后宣布正式离职。退出日常管理后，她将以兼职顾问身份继续为公司提供战略指导与业务支持。

items.title: Aurora 1.5: Extending open foundation models for weather and Earth-system applications
items.title_cn: Aurora 1.5开源大模型发布：新增22项变量，大幅提升天气与气候预测实用性
items.summary: Aurora 1.5 adds 22 more variables, hourly temporal resolution, and probabilistic ensemble forecasting to the Aurora foundation model, making it more useful for real-world weather, climate, and energy
items.summary_cn: Aurora 1.5开源模型重磅升级，新增22项气象变量、小时级时间分辨率及概率集合预报功能。此次更新将直接赋能现实世界的天气、气候及能源行业，提供更精准的预测支持。

items.title: Say hello to Claude Wrapped
items.title_cn: Anthropic推出“Claude年度回顾”：一键总结你的AI使用习惯
items.summary: The popularity of Spotify Wrapped has kicked off a wide range of year-in-review features, on apps from YouTube to Uber - and now, the lookback trend has come to AI. Anthropic on Thursday announced a "
items.summary_cn: 继Spotify之后，年度回顾热潮席卷人工智能领域。Anthropic正式推出“Claude Wrapped”功能，帮助用户一键生成个性化年度报告，直观回顾过去一年的AI互动数据与高频使用偏好。

items.title: Microsoft’s patch Tuesdays are about to get bigger
items.title_cn: 微软引入AI加速漏洞修复：Windows 11系统补丁将更全面高效
items.summary: Windows 11 updates could soon include fixes for more security issues at once. Microsoft said in a blog post on Thursday that it's now using AI to "identify potential issues earlier," which means "cust
items.summary_cn: 微软宣布引入AI技术提前识别潜在安全漏洞。这使得Windows 11未来的“补丁星期二”能一次性修复更多安全问题，大幅提升系统更新效率，为用户提供更可靠的安全防护。

items.title: OpenAI pairs its GPT-5.6 public rollout with ChatGPT Work, a new agent that handles entire workflows
items.title_cn: OpenAI公开发布GPT-5.6，同步推出AI Agent实现复杂工作流自动化
items.summary: OpenAI is launching ChatGPT Work, an agent-based product powered by Codex and the now publicly available GPT-5.6. The agent can independently handle complex projects across apps like Google Drive, Sla
items.summary_cn: OpenAI公开发布GPT-5.6，并同步推出由Codex驱动的新产品ChatGPT Work。该Agent可跨Google Drive、Slack等平台独立处理复杂任务，帮助企业实现端到端的工作流自动化。

items.title: Behind the Scenes of Distributed Training and Why Your GPU Wiring Matters as Much as Your Strategy
items.title_cn: 深度解析分布式训练：GPU物理连接与算法策略同等重要
items.summary:
A measured look at distributed training, from DDP and FSDP to the ZeRO stages in between, and why the wiring between your GPUs matters as much as the strategy you choose
The post Behind the Scenes of
items.summary_cn: 本文深度解析大模型分布式训练（涵盖DDP、FSDP及ZeRO）。文章指出，构建高效训练集群时，GPU的物理连线网络与算法策略同等关键，两者共同决定了最终的模型训练效率与算力成本。

items.title: 奥尔特曼：OpenAI最新AI模型在代理型编程任务中token效率提升54%
items.title_cn: OpenAI最新模型Agent编程效率提升54%，大幅降低开发成本
items.summary: 据报道，OpenAI创始人奥尔特曼表示，OpenAI最新的AI模型在代理型编程任务中，token效率提升了54%。（界面）
items.summary_cn: OpenAI创始人奥尔特曼透露，最新AI模型在Agent编程任务中的token效率大幅提升54%。这意味着开发者能用更少资源完成复杂代码任务，有效降低AI应用成本。

items.title: Positron洽谈7.5亿美元融资，估值最高或达50亿美元
items.title_cn: 挑战英伟达：AI芯片创企Positron拟融资7.5亿美元，估值冲向50亿美元
items.summary: AI推理芯片初创公司Positron正与投资者洽谈分两阶段融资约7.5亿美元，首轮预计估值35亿美元，第二轮估值约50亿美元。若顺利完成，这家仅成立三年的公司估值将在五个月内增长两倍以上。（新浪财经）
items.summary_cn: AI芯片初创公司Positron正洽谈7.5亿美元融资，估值有望达50亿美元。成立仅三年估值五个月翻三倍，彰显市场对GPU替代方案的热烈追捧与投资渴望。

items.title: 美联储7月维持利率不变的概率为74.9%
items.title_cn: 美联储7月维持利率概率近75%，科技创业公司迎资金喘息期
items.summary: 据CME“美联储观察”：美联储7月维持利率不变的概率为74.9%，累计加息25个基点的概率为25.1%。 美联储到9月维持利率不变的概率为35.7%，累计加息25个基点的概率为51.1%，累计加息50个基点的概率为13.1%。（财联社）
items.summary_cn: 据CME数据，美联储7月维持利率不变的概率高达74.9%。高息环境的暂缓为科技和AI初创企业在融资和估值方面提供了宝贵的战略调整窗口。

items.title: SK海力士募资265亿美元，刷新外国企业赴美IPO纪录
items.title_cn: SK海力士赴美IPO募资265亿美元，创外国企业纪录加码AI芯片
items.summary: 当地时间7月9日，SK海力士通过美国存托股份（ADS）发行募资265亿美元，成为外国企业在美国规模最大的首次公开募股。SK海力士以每份149美元发行1.779亿份ADS，ADS将于7月10日在纳斯达克开始交易，代码为“SKHYV”。（界面）
items.summary_cn: SK海力士通过美股IPO成功募资265亿美元，创下外国企业在美最大上市纪录。巨额资金将为其扩大AI必备的高带宽存储（HBM）芯片产能提供强劲动力。

items.title: Patch for Windows Defender 0-day could allow attackers to fill hard disk
items.title_cn: Windows Defender曝出0-day漏洞，攻击者可撑爆硬盘导致系统瘫痪
items.summary: The feud between NightmareEclipse and Microsoft shows no signs of resolving soon.
